teaser: You make the platform return typed JSON, cap every run with turn and budget limits, then wire in retries, cost tracking and monitoring.
takeaways: Structured outputs: set output_format to a json_schema; the validated object arrives in ResultMessage.structured_output.
Schema validation that keeps failing yields subtype error_max_structured_output_retries; with Pydantic, use Model.model_json_schema().
max_turns ends a run with subtype error_max_turns, max_budget_usd with error_max_budget_usd; single-shot query() then raises ClaudeSDKError.
total_cost_usd is a client-side estimate; usage covers the main loop, model_usage adds subagents. Never bypassPermissions outside a sandbox.
